baselineDisplay.title: A Famous Actress
baselineDisplay.question: Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 谁的年龄只有 29 岁？为什么这一点如此难以确定呢？
baselineDisplay.text:
Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?

Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
I think I can, Kate.
It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
I thought so.
Who's that beside her?
That must be Conrad Reeves.
Conrad Reeves, the actor?
It can't be.
Let me have another look.
I think you're right!
Isn't he her third husband?
No.
He must be her fourth or fifth.
Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!
She does, doesn't she!
I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
I'm sure she is.
She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
Not that long ago!
I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
你能认出那个女人吗，莉兹？
我想我能认出来，凯特。
那一定是凯伦·马什，那位女演员。
我也这么认为。
她旁边的是谁？
那一定是康拉德·里夫斯。
康拉德·里夫斯，那位演员？
不可能是他。
让我再看看。
我觉得你是对的！
他不是她的第三任丈夫吗？
不是。
他一定是她的第四或第五任丈夫。
凯伦·马什看起来真老啊！
是啊，她看起来是挺老的。
我记得她才29岁，但实际上她至少有40岁了。
我肯定她有。
我还在上学的时候，她就已经是著名演员了。
那已经是很久以前的事了，对吧？
没那么久吧！
我自己也才 29 岁。
